testimonials.text: I really enjoyed the video most because it was very hands on. I felt like I could do it myself.
The course was productive and really interesting, have learnt a lot.
The video demonstration, it put such a complex process to an understandable lesson.
The explanation was clear and loved the change of view with the camera for a better understanding of the technique.
I found the vertical mattress suturing technique most interesting, particularly how the far-far, near-near method helps close wounds under tension and properly evert the wound edges.
